summary: Iteration 2 tested new Daily Expense module + Prathvi Power Solutions rebrand. Backend: 36/36 pytest passing covering CRUD (create/read/update/delete with parameterized /api/expenses/item/{id}), validation (amount<=0, invalid payment_mode, empty category, bad date), listing filters (q/category/payment_mode/date range/sort/limit/skip), count, budget get/set with YYYY-MM month key, summary/dashboard (all required keys), analytics (monthly=6 buckets, category, weekly=14 buckets, payment), Excel export (Content-Disposition attachment .xlsx), backup+restore-merge, and existing resource endpoints (19 seeds, stats, activity, patch). Frontend: /expenses page loads with all listed data-testids present (expense-form, expense-input-*, expense-payment-cash, expense-form-save, expense-table, budget-manager, expense-search, filter-category, filter-mode, btn-export-excel, btn-backup, sort-date, sort-amount, delete-confirm/delete-confirm-btn). Sidebar shows brand 'Prathvi Power Solutions' and nav-daily-expenses navigates to /expenses. Overview has open-expenses-module button. Add-expense flow (Amount=500, Category=Food, Cash, description) creates a row and updates Today card to ₹500.00. Search filter narrows to matching row. Sort clicks OK. Delete opens confirm modal (delete-confirm) and delete-confirm-btn removes row (toast 'Expense deleted' observed). Budget set to 1000 persists. Theme toggle present.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~720 lines and mixes Resource + Expense modules; consider splitting into routers/expenses.py, routers/resources.py for maintainability.
analytics_monthly uses (months-1)*31 days offset to compute start month; for large 'months' this could drift. Prefer proper month arithmetic (relativedelta or manual year/month rollback).

restore_expenses accepts arbitrary dicts and $set's them upsert without pydantic validation; malicious payload could inject unexpected fields. Consider validating each entry against Expense model before writing.
No auth on any endpoint (accepted per spec, but flagging: expense endpoints are publicly writable). Consider rate-limiting POSTs at minimum.
Excel export streams up to 10k rows in memory - fine now, but may need pagination/streaming write for large datasets.
seed_data_creation: Created temp TEST_ expense entries and one budget=1000 (current month) during testing. Test rows deleted via UI + module teardown. Budget for current month remains 1000 (harmless, easily overwritten by user).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_expenses.py (36 tests, all green). Parameterized expense routes use /api/expenses/item/{id}. Budget month format YYYY-MM. Frontend testids used exactly as specified; brand string is 'Prathvi Power Solutions'. Validation errors on the form are surfaced via toast/inline (not necessarily [class*=error]) but empty/negative amount does prevent save.
